The '''Party Chest''' is a chest that has a {{Green|1-3%}} chance (depending on the Mob) of appearing when killing any mob during the [[Spooky Festival]] whilst {{NPCSprite|Foxy|alt=Foxy's}} {{Pink|A Time for Giving}} perk is active. After the player interacts with a Party Chest, it will open similarly to a [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]. If the chest is left untouched it will despawn and disappear after some time. The chest will also despawn if the player leaves a 20-block radius surrounding the Party Chest.

The player cannot open another player's Party Chest or steal their rewards.

__TOC__
== Rewards ==
Opening a '''Party Chest''' rewards the player with 2-4 pieces of loot.
